test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: Has two strings to his bow

options.text: He has backup skills to depend on

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. He has backup skills to depend on. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Has two strings to his bow"** means that someone has an alternative or backup skill/resource to rely on. (किसी के पास बैकअप या वैकल्पिक कौशल होना) • **Example:** John has two strings to his bow: he's a talented musician and a skilled software engineer. • In the context of this idiom, it implies preparedness or having multiple options. (तैयार रहना या कई विकल्प होना) • **Example:** She has two strings to her bow – if her writing career doesn’t take off, she can always fall back on her teaching skills. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. He has backup skills to depend on. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: He makes risky decisions** (वह जोखिम भरे निर्णय लेता है): This does not relate to the meaning of the idiom. • **Example:** Taking a loan to invest in an unstable market is an example of making risky decisions. • **Option 3: He manages two tasks poorly** (वह दो कार्यों को खराब तरीके से प्रबंधित करता है): This is incorrect as the idiom refers to having alternative skills, not poor task management. • **Example:** Handling both studies and work poorly may lead to failure in both areas. • **Option 4: He avoids responsibility** (वह जिम्मेदारी से बचता है): This is unrelated to the idiom's meaning. • **Example:** Avoiding responsibility can harm one’s reputation at work. 33:Td90, The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e., Book admirer.
